title: Work Projection Reconciliation
description: Read-only reconciliation of the single canonical work writer (TaskStore) against relay/work-graph/github/kanban projections. TaskStore is the only operational writer; every other system is a derived projection keyed by taskstore_id and is never a second WorkRegistry.

canonical.description: The canonical TaskStore rows — the only operational work identities.

projections.description: Read-only projections. Each references exactly one canonical TaskStore identity; projection references are explicitly null when unbound (missing keys are invalid). No projection may be a write target.
